clue.text: Agree to keep in touch

definitions.meaning: to tally or match, as two accounts do

explanation.surface: Someone consents to stay in contact.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both matching up with something and writing letters back and forth.

clue.text: Love the jerk of listener

parts.note: O is a score of nil in tennis, called love
a tic is a twitch or spasm

explanation.surface: A partner's affection for a twitchy companion who listens.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'listener' is the ear, so the definition means relating to the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Otic is the anatomical adjective for things belonging to the ear.

clue.text: Object to being ordered to go again

explanation.surface: Someone bitter about being sent back out.
explanation.definitionFit: It means take offence at, and also, split up, despatched a second time.

clue.text: Stuff for firing

definitions.meaning: coarse material, as in hessian fabric

explanation.surface: Material used to start a bonfire.
explanation.definitionFit: It is coarse fabric used for bags, and also dismissal from employment.

clue.text: Stone work a sovereign wanted

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
a sovereign was a gold pound coin, and L stands for pound

explanation.surface: A jeweller's commission paid for in gold coin.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is an old British gold coin worth a pound, abbreviated L.
explanation.definitionFit: Opal is an iridescent gemstone.

clue.text: Underworld boss left to make merry

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the dead
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Hell's ruler departs to have a good time.
explanation.definitionFit: To disport oneself is to frolic and amuse oneself.

clue.text: Antipodean saturnalia should be broken up

indicators.note: a party broken up is scattered, so the letters of saturnalia are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wild Down Under festival that ought to be stopped.
explanation.definitionFit: The Antipodes are Australia and New Zealand, seen from Britain.

clue.text: Take account of rise in value

definitions.meaning: to go up in worth, as property does

explanation.surface: An accountant noting an asset's growth.
explanation.definitionFit: It means to recognise the worth of something and also to grow in market worth.

clue.text: Interrogate-and put one's foot in it!

definitions.meaning: to question someone persistently for information
read literally: something you slip a foot into, a light dancing shoe

explanation.surface: A grilling where the questioner blunders and says the wrong thing.
explanation.definitionFit: To grill someone for facts is one sense; the other is a light slip-on shoe, which a foot goes into.

clue.text: Children just starting school should be very good

definitions.meaning: the year group of new pupils, the opening form

explanation.surface: A remark that the youngest pupils ought to behave well.
explanation.definitionFit: The first form of pupils is one sense; the other is top-quality, as in a premium rail ticket.

clue.text: The minister may be a sport

indicators.note: says these letters could become something else when rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A suggestion that the clergyman is a good loser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' turns the letters of A SPORT into a new word.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastor is a church minister in charge of a congregation.

clue.text: Working out expenses gives the company a pain!

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company
a sting is a sharp pain

explanation.surface: Doing the accounts is a misery for the firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Calculating what something will cost is the job of a price estimate.

clue.text: Giving in to deceive, since so devious

parts.note: to con is to trick

indicators.note: devious means twisting, so the letters of since so are rearranged

explanation.surface: Yielding to cheat because one is so crafty.
explanation.definitionFit: A concession is a yielding of a point.

clue.text: An attitude put up with over a period

indicators.note: in a down entry, the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: to stand something is to tolerate it
a point is a full stop, called a period in the US

explanation.surface: A stance tolerated for a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: A point of view is someone's attitude.

clue.text: Coarse aggregate

explanation.surface: Rough gravel.
explanation.definitionFit: It means vulgar and also the total sum before deductions.

clue.text: Ancient chief, really tip-top, with clear head

parts.note: arch- means principal, as in archenemy
A1 means first-rate, written AI in the grid

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, so take the start of clear

explanation.surface: A very old leader, excellent and thinking straight.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-class) is entered as AI. 'head' takes the C from 'clear'.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic means belonging to an old, bygone period.

clue.text: An emotion some people consider dangerous

indicators.note: only some of the word dangerous is used, a run of its letters

explanation.surface: A feeling that certain people regard as risky.
explanation.definitionFit: Anger is a strong feeling of displeasure.

clue.text: The American president 12

definitions.meaning: Ulysses S. ..., US president after the Civil War
refers to the answer at 12 down, a concession or allowance given

explanation.surface: A cross-reference naming a US leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulysses Grant was the eighteenth US president; a grant is also something conceded or allowed.

clue.text: Well-nigh parsimonious

explanation.surface: Almost a miser.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means close by or almost, and in an older sense mean or tight-fisted.

clue.text: Sorting mail for a foreign city

indicators.note: sorting the post rearranges it, so the letters of mail go into a new order

explanation.surface: Post being sorted for delivery abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Lima is the capital of Peru.

clue.text: Wooden pale

definitions.meaning: made of the timber of the tree of that name

explanation.surface: Stiff and white-faced, like a nervous actor.
explanation.definitionFit: It can mean made of the timber of that tree, or deathly pallid in the face.

clue.text: Divided, though no less supportive

parts.note: as means equally, no less, as in as good
something under another holds it up

explanation.surface: Two people split up yet still backing each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Asunder means apart, in pieces.

clue.text: A celebrity's back on the list

indicators.note: back means the short word on is read backwards

parts.note: a table is a list of figures

explanation.surface: A famous person is restored to the roster.
explanation.definitionFit: A notable is a well-known person.

clue.text: Not interrupted without a goal

parts.note: an end is an aim or objective
-less is the suffix meaning without

explanation.surface: A football match that ran on with nobody scoring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without a goal' reads as goal-less, so the word for goal is followed by LESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unbroken goes on continuously with no stop.

clue.text: A novel more can read in translation

indicators.note: translating changes words into a new form, so the letters of more can are rearranged

explanation.surface: A book that many more people can enjoy once translated.
explanation.definitionFit: A romance is a work of fiction, often a love story.

clue.text: Confers, as draw is to be made

indicators.note: the letters are to be made into a different word

explanation.surface: Grants an honour, as a lottery draw is held.
explanation.definitionFit: Awards as a verb means grants or bestows.

clue.text: Don't go out to finish up in the wrong

indicators.note: says one piece is placed up inside the other, as a down-going container would hold it

parts.note: a sin is a wrongdoing
to top something off is to finish it

explanation.surface: Advice not to leave the house and end up in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up in' is the container signal: in a down-style reading the finishing word goes up into the word for wrongdoing, and 'to' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay indoors rather than going out for the evening.

clue.text: Quietly dock in the sound

parts.note: p is piano, quietly in music
to dock a tail is to lop it

explanation.surface: Softly mooring a boat in a harbour inlet.
explanation.definitionFit: Plop is the noise of something dropping into water.

clue.text: An inscription that's sent up the public school

indicators.note: in a down entry, sent up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a note is a short written message

explanation.surface: A carved message mocking a posh school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent up' turns NOTE around. Eton is a famous fee-paying British boarding school near Windsor.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton College is a famous fee-paying English school.

clue.text: Weigh as planned

explanation.surface: A scale reading taken as intended.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to ponder at length; as an adjective, intentional.

clue.text: French department in the North or North-east

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east

explanation.surface: A geography question about a region in northern France.
explanation.definitionFit: The Orne is a department of Normandy in northern France.

clue.text: Having to do with all-important checking

parts.note: re means concerning or about
pressing means urgent, demanding attention

explanation.surface: A remark about crucial matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding back or restraining something is curbing it.
